lineage.core_design: garden notices, coded repairs, and final-gate completion records

chapters.title: Route-code map
chapters.body: On the Flint Garden registry, repair code K-4 denotes work performed in Frost Court; the map does not identify a particular repair.

chapters.title: Repair receipt
chapters.body: Eli Vann's hinge repair receipt bears route code K-4; another receipt for a gate latch bears K-9.

chapters.title: Completion definition
chapters.body: A seed-gate delivery is complete only if both the delivery stamp is present and the final gate latch is closed.

chapters.title: Latch log
chapters.body: The seed-gate log records a delivery stamp, but says the final gate latch remained open.

chapters.title: Pruning tool
chapters.body: Noma Rusk trims the frost hedge with a crescent shear; a nearby rake entry refers to leaf collection only.

chapters.title: Court bell
chapters.body: Frost Court opens after one brass bell and two reed bells.

chapters.title: Unconfirmed cause
chapters.body: A cracked pot was found after rain, but no record identifies whether wind, frost, or a person caused it.

chapters.title: Inspection without outcome
chapters.body: The Kite Shed gate was inspected, but the inspector recorded no pass or fail result.
